priorities.heading: Jobs, Costs & the Economy
priorities.quote: She is fighting to bring jobs home, take away tax breaks from companies that ship jobs overseas, and for tariffs that protect Ohio-based factories and companies.

priorities.heading: Immigration & Our Border
priorities.quote: She has voted to improve and expand border security, to hire more than 10,000 border agents, and to enable military presence at the border if needed.

priorities.heading: Energy, Infrastructure & Housing

cost-of-living.heading: Meet Derek
cost-of-living.quote: He is a strong advocate for lower taxes, simplifying the tax code, and promoting transparency.

housing.heading: Meet Derek
housing.quote: After a five-year push, Merrin pushed through the Affordable Homebuilding & Housing Act, which blocks property tax increases on subdivided lots until the home is built or lot is sold.
housing.note: An Ohio state law he passed, from his biography.

health-care.heading: Meet Derek
health-care.quote: He previously served as Chairman of the House Health Committee where he advocated for policies to reduce healthcare costs, promote price transparency, and ensure better patient access through fewer regulations.
health-care.note: From his time in the Ohio House, per his biography.
